description: Answers 'What would it take to reach a target rank?' — takes your current 4 token pillars and a target percentile (e.g. 90 for top 10%), then simulates the smallest metric changes needed to reach that position. Returns: current rank/percentile, simulated rank/percentile, the specific pillar changes required, and the yield delta. This turns SigRank from a scoreboard into a simulator. Use it when someone asks 'what would move my rank?' or 'how do I get to top 10%?'.

target_percentile.description: Target percentile (0-100). E.g. 90 for top 10%, 99 for top 1%.

name: rank_if
title: Rank If — Counterfactual Rank Simulator
